objective: Preserve only the active suffix dropped by Desktop rewind or gateway /retry as inactive, non-compacted rows; keep legitimate hard-rewrite callers destructive; expose read-only recovery.

frozenInterfaces.semantics: Within one SQLite write transaction, compare the current active persisted conversation with expected_history, resolve the active user row at the exact ordinal, set that row and its active suffix to active=0, update rewind_count plus active message/tool counters, and return target/new-head metadata. A mismatch raises before mutation. The retained prefix is never deleted or reinserted.

frozenInterfaces.contract: An r2 id remains the external identity. Existing r2 resolution and opening-turn confirmation run first; I1 is the canonical persistence commit. session.history changes only after I1 succeeds. Identity or persisted-history mismatch returns existing stale-rewind error 4018 with no turn launch and no state mutation.

frozenInterfaces.semantics: Wrap I1 for gateway callers. /retry must check False/exception and must not resend on persistence failure. rewrite_transcript remains a destructive full-replacement primitive for redaction and other explicit callers.

Default output is unchanged and active-only. include_rewound=True returns active rows plus rows where active=0 and compacted=0, preserving row content and state fields while excluding compaction archives.
Read-only recovery. --include-rewound is restricted to one session and JSONL and is incompatible with --only, logical-lineage aggregation, and --delete-after-verified. No default export changes.

frozenInterfaces.contract: No new configuration or message-level TTL
frozenInterfaces.semantics: Rewound rows remain with the session and are deleted only when the existing authorized whole-session pruning/deletion contract removes that session.

dependencyEdges.contract: Existing r2 rewind_id plus dedicated opening-turn confirmation; no positional fallback when an id is present.
Exact occurrence/ordinal/content binding; stale or shifted identity returns 4018 before persistence.
Pass the full expected active history and exact target user ordinal; never pass only a retained prefix to replace_messages.
Single write transaction archives exact active suffix and updates rewind/message/tool counters; retained prefix and old inactive rows are untouched.
DB is authoritative; memory truncation and turn launch occur only after successful commit. Failure preserves pre-call state.
Archive the latest retry target through I1 and check success; rewrite_transcript remains destructive for explicit hard-rewrite callers.
Read one resolved session; include active plus inactive non-compacted rows; expose row-state fields; no mutation.
Live replay stays active-only. Ordinary search continues active=1 OR compacted=1 and therefore hides rewind rows while retaining compaction behavior.
No direct main commit, merge, push, deploy, or clearance. Only COO-transported reland receipt and later Sakaan authority can advance lifecycle.
Port the accepted diff onto exact Desktop base, exclude apps/desktop/electron/main.ts, run the same semantic tests, and obtain a separate reland-gate receipt.
